The '''E-Web Missile Launcher''' or referred as a "'''Swarm Turret'''" was a heavy, tripod-mounted firing mechanization, from which anti-personnel rockets and ground-to-air missiles were launched. It was modified from the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] and unlike its predecessor, it did not require a power generator. While one person could operate it with two hands, a second crew member would reload the launcher between the shots, jamming live missiles into the launch tubes. They were often deployed by the Empire during the [[Rise of the Empire era|Rise of the Empire]] and early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and were used in various Imperial locations, including the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].
